feed_summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-107441, the out-of-bounds write flaw could allow attackers to execute OS commands via crafted HTTP requests. The post Zyxel Switch Hacks Blamed on Patched Flaw Actually Exploited a Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Zyxel Switch Hacks Blamed on Patched Flaw Actually Exploited a Zero-Day
